name: size_bearing_width
description: Does the controller use the perceived target width? Width alone is scaled by 0.5, 0.75, 1.25 or 1.5 (no range change), on the car-car, cyclist (car-sized box) and bicycle (0.6 m wide box, import-tasc --bicycle) cases. example_aeb uses width to decide whether a target is in its path; whether HiDrive does is not known. No randomness. Sensitivity levels, not sensor values. 700 runs.
